findings.evidence: `FiniteTypeTrivial.lean:60` defines `unit`, while `rg -n "counit" code/TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/FiniteTypeTrivial.lean` has no hits; Mathlib already provides `Bialgebra.counitBialgHom : A →ₐc[R] R` at `Mathlib/RingTheory/Bialgebra/Hom.lean:350`.
findings.fix: Add `noncomputable abbrev counit (H) : H ⟶ trivial R := ofHom (Bialgebra.counitBialgHom R H)` plus `@[simp] toBialgHom_counit` and `@[simp] counit_apply`/characteristic lemmas as appropriate.
findings.issue: Only `unit : trivial R ⟶ H` is bundled; there is no public `counit : H ⟶ trivial R` with unwrap/apply lemmas.

summary: The finite-type trivial object exposes the outgoing unit and initiality API, but it omits the corresponding finite-type wrapper for the Hopf counit. That leaves the identity-section/coordinate-counit side of the characteristic API unavailable without manually unwrapping through `ofHom`.
